summary.en: How this website is protected, and how to report a problem.
summary.fr: Comment ce site est protégé, et comment signaler un problème.
summary.ar: كيف يُحمى هذا الموقع، وكيف تبلّغ عن مشكلة.

lead.en: How this website is protected, and how to report a problem. It makes no certification claims.

items.en: The site is static files. There is no application server or database to attack in the published build.
A strict Content-Security-Policy allows scripts, styles, fonts and images from the site's own origin only.
There are no third-party scripts, trackers, fonts or embedded widgets.
Transport security and content-type headers are set by the host.

body.en: W5D holds no security certification, such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001, and has had no independent penetration test. Earlier template copy that implied otherwise was removed.

note.en: Not promised here because none has been decided.

text.en: Write to the security desk with the page address and how to reproduce the problem.
